label.label: Bar prefix
label.description: Text shown before the percentage, e.g. OC

display.label: Display
display.description: Which limits to show in the bar itself; the tooltip always lists all three

refresh_minutes.label: Refresh interval (minutes)
refresh_minutes.description: How often the dashboard page is re-read

credentials_file.label: Credentials file
credentials_file.description: Path to a 0600 JSON file with {"workspace_id": ..., "token": ...}; falls back to the OPENCODE_GO_WORKSPACE / OPENCODE_GO_TOKEN env vars
